# `<ptfkit/weynants2009.h>`

```c
#include <ptfkit/weynants2009.h>
```

Corrected Weynants et al. hydraulic-parameter pedotransfer function.

## Source

Weynants, M., Vereecken, H., & Javaux, M. (2009). Revisiting Vereecken pedotransfer functions: Introducing a closed-form hydraulic model. Vadose Zone Journal, 8(1), 86-95.

[DOI: 10.2136/vzj2008.0062](https://doi.org/10.2136/vzj2008.0062)

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/weynants2009.md)

## `weynants2009_ptf_result`

```c
typedef struct {
    double theta_r;
    double theta_s;
    double alpha;
    double n;
    double k0;
    double tau;
 } weynants2009_ptf_result;
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | Residual volumetric soil water content fixed at zero. (m3/m3) |
| `theta_s` | Saturated volumetric soil water content. (m3/m3) |
| `alpha` | Inverse pressure-scale parameter of the van Genuchten model. (cm^-1) |
| `n` | Pore-size distribution parameter of the van Genuchten model. (dimensionless) |
| `k0` | Matrix matching-point hydraulic conductivity at zero pressure head. (cm/day) |
| `tau` | Mualem pore-connectivity and tortuosity parameter. (dimensionless) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_weynants2009` {#function-calc_ptf_weynants2009}

Estimate six van Genuchten-Mualem hydraulic parameters from texture, bulk density, and organic carbon.

```c
static inline weynants2009_ptf_result calc_ptf_weynants2009(double clay, double sand, double bulk_density, double organic_carbon);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | in | Particles smaller than 2 micrometres as a mass percentage of fine earth. (%) |
| `sand` | in | Particles from 0.05 to 2 millimetres as a mass percentage of fine earth. (%) |
| `bulk_density` | in | Dry bulk density; values in g/cm^3 are numerically equal to values in Mg/m^3. (g/cm^3) |
| `organic_carbon` | in | Organic carbon as a percentage by mass, following the mandatory 2017 erratum. (%) |

#### Returns

A `weynants2009_ptf_result` value.

!!! note

    K0 is the matrix matching-point conductivity at zero pressure head, not measured macropore-influenced saturated conductivity.

!!! note

    The software evaluates the equations without input guards, texture-sum checks, output clamps, or out-of-domain errors.

!!! warning

    Supply organic carbon in percent by mass, not in the g/kg unit printed in the original 2009 table.

!!! warning

    The corrected training ranges are sand 5.60-97.80%, clay 0-54.50%, bulk density 0.89-1.77 g/cm^3, and organic carbon 0.01-6.60%; these are marginal ranges rather than a joint applicability hull.

!!! warning

    The fitted conductivity model is unsuitable for prediction at pressure heads greater than -6 cm because observations with absolute pressure head below 6 cm were excluded.
